review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of cs_app::objectives::recover_retail_objectives on zbd/c1c/m01 (family-verdict.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: the integration finding docs/findings/2026-10-12-m01-b-obj-integration-family-verdict.md joins the four stages' findings (2026-10-12-m01-b-obj-1..4) into one verdict: of M01's 358 fields, 308 are recovered into the engine model across eight measured families and 50 remain unrecovered in the two directive families whose world-side operations the declared program does not represent; no field is left Unmeasured, and program() refuses naming exactly those families (its computed refusal text is recorded verbatim in family-verdict.json). LIMITS: the family measurements are static code readings of $CS_ENGINE_IMAGE and retail-data censuses; no original executable was run, so nothing here is verified_original runtime behaviour, and the directive families' remaining unknowns are those recorded in the M01-B-OBJ-4 finding. TEST-SELECTION NOTE: the prefix accept_m01_b_obj_integration_ is unique to this task, so the 3 discovered assertions are exactly this task's tests. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
